meta.title: Input
meta.lead: All input types are consistently styled and come with validation states.

blocks.label: Input examples
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Input examples" class="component"><form><input aria-label="Text" name="text" placeholder="Text" type="text"/><input aria-label="Email" autocomplete="email" name="email" placeholder="Email" type="email"/><input aria-label="Number" name="number" placeholder="Number" type="number"/><input aria-label="Password" autocomplete="current-password" name="password" placeholder="Password" type="password"/><input aria-label="Tel" autocomplete="tel" name="tel" placeholder="Tel" type="tel"/><input aria-label="Url" name="url" placeholder="Url" type="url"/></form></article>
blocks.code:
<input type="text" name="text" placeholder="Text" aria-label="Text">
<input type="email" name="email" placeholder="Email" aria-label="Email" autocomplete="email">
<input type="number" name="number" placeholder="Number" aria-label="Number">
<input type="password" name="password" placeholder="Password" aria-label="Password">
<input type="tel" name="tel" placeholder="Tel" aria-label="Tel" autocomplete="tel">
<input type="url" name="url" placeholder="Url" aria-label="Url">

blocks.md: Datetime inputs come with an icon.

blocks.label: Datetime input examples
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Datetime input examples" class="component"><form><input aria-label="Date" name="date" type="date"/><input aria-label="Datetime local" name="datetime-local" type="datetime-local"/><input aria-label="Month" name="month" type="month"/><input aria-label="Time" name="time" type="time"/></form></article>
blocks.code:
<input type="date" name="date" aria-label="Date">
<input type="datetime-local" name="datetime-local" aria-label="Datetime local">
<input type="month" name="month" aria-label="Month">
<input type="time" name="time" aria-label="Time">

blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Search input example" class="component"><input aria-label="Search" name="search" placeholder="Search" type="search"/></article>

blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Color input example" class="component"><input aria-label="Color picker" type="color" value="#ff9500"/></article>

blocks.md: Input type file button has a [*secondary* button style](https://picocss.com/docs/button#variants).

blocks.label: Disabled example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Disabled example" class="component"><input aria-label="Disabled input" disabled="" name="text" placeholder="Disabled" type="text"/></article>
blocks.code:
<input
  type="text"
  name="text"
  placeholder="Disabled"
  aria-label="Disabled input"
  disabled
>

blocks.label: Disabled example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Disabled example" class="component"><input aria-label="Read-only input" name="text" readonly="" type="text" value="Read-only"/></article>
blocks.code:
<input
  type="text"
  name="text"
  value="Read-only"
  aria-label="Read-only input"
  readonly
>

blocks.label: Validation states example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Validation states example" class="component"><input aria-invalid="false" name="valid" placeholder="Valid" type="text" value="Valid"/><input aria-invalid="true" name="invalid" placeholder="Invalid" type="text" value="Invalid"/></article>
blocks.code:
<input
  type="text"
  name="valid"
  value="Valid"
  aria-invalid="false"
>

<input
  type="text"
  name="invalid"
  value="Invalid"
  aria-invalid="true"
>

blocks.md: Helper texts, defined with `<small>` below the form element, inherit the validation state color.

blocks.label: Validation states example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Validation states example" class="component"><input aria-describedby="valid-helper" aria-invalid="false" name="valid" placeholder="Valid" type="text" value="Valid"/><small id="valid-helper">Looks good!</small><input aria-describedby="invalid-helper" aria-invalid="true" name="invalid" placeholder="Invalid" type="text" value="Invalid"/><small id="invalid-helper">Please provide a valid value!</small></article>
blocks.code:
<input
  type="text"
  name="valid"
  value="Valid"
  aria-invalid="false"
  aria-describedby="valid-helper"
>
<small id="valid-helper">Looks good!</small>

<input
  type="text"
  name="invalid"
  value="Invalid"
  aria-invalid="true"
  aria-describedby="invalid-helper"
>
<small id="invalid-helper">
  Please provide a valid value!
</small>
